column1: ## Establishes cognitive architecture: learnability, suggestion, science-as-reach, headroom, math-as-precognition, God-as-Science.

column4: The speculation engine learns from each deed record, each recursive pass. Property patterns compound — the model must absorb and integrate without loss across iterations.
Speculations are cognitive suggestions — possible interpretations of financial and property data. They are never presented as fact until corroborated by source records.
Property analysis as science reaches beyond individual deeds toward systemic understanding — ownership concentration, wealth flows, community formation. The reach exceeds any single record.
The IQ-spectrum spatial model is headroom — it represents analytical capacity above raw data retrieval. Each training pass expands this headroom for deeper recursive speculation.
Spatial models and exponential falloff functions are precognitive — they predict property value trajectories and ownership patterns before they materialize in new recordings.
The economic and moral order underlying property ownership is unmovable. The engine analyzes within this order — it discovers just distribution principles; it does not author them.
